# #229 Gym players never get band or bodyweight working sets
## Parent
#224
## What to build
A Commercial gym player is never prescribed or suggested band or bodyweight working sets, pull-ups and dips included, so every exercise can be progressively overloaded. Home gym players get free weights, bands and bodyweight; Bodyweight-only players get programs they can do. The player's own explicit search is never filtered, and warm-up movements are exempt.
## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Generating for a Commercial gym player yields no band or bodyweight working sets on any split or frequency - [ ] Suggested substitutes (logger and chat, when no specific exercise is named) exclude band and bodyweight for Commercial gym players - [ ] Explicit name search still returns a pull-up if the player searches for it, and the player may log it - [ ] Home gym programs use only free weights, bands and bodyweight; Bodyweight-only programs use only bodyweight - [ ] Warm-up movements are unaffected - [ ] Tests at the generation and library search seams cover each Equipment access value
